newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS CEO sees no U.S. stock crash.
newsitem.headline: UBS CEO sees no U.S. stock crash.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) chief executive Mathis Cabiallavetta said he did not believe that U.S. stock markets were headed for a big crash.
"I believe the financial sector is highly valued, but I do not believe in a big crash," he said, refering to U.S. stock markets.
Cabiallavetta told a seminar on U.S. markets organised by the Swiss-American Chamber of Commerce that demand for equities in the U.S. was still growing.
"There has been a small 'sobering-up'," he said, in discussing the Dow Jones Industrial index and broader indices.
But he said savings in shares were expanding, while social security providers and pension funds were also growing in terms of assets.
